issues.title: M1: Portable foundation
issues.body:
Workspaces, schema and migrations, auth, tenant scoping, CI, docs and ADRs.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] pnpm install --frozen-lockfile, lint, typecheck, test, build pass in CI
- [ ] Migrations apply to PostgreSQL 17 with pgvector
- [ ] No secrets committed; .env.example has placeholders only
- [ ] README quickstart works from a clean checkout

See docs/ROADMAP.md. Do not claim completion without evidence (README status wording).

issues.title: M2: OpenClaw integration
issues.body:
AgentRuntime adapter (real + mock), pinned client, tools-denied Gateway guidance and a repeatable smoke procedure.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Mock mode works with no credentials
- [ ] Real adapter has unit tests against a fake connection
- [ ] Smoke run against a real Gateway recorded with versions, or marked unverified
- [ ] Client and protocol packages pinned to the same version

See docs/ROADMAP.md. Do not claim completion without evidence (README status wording).

issues.title: M3: Business data and memory
issues.body:
Customers, jobs, notes, search, knowledge items with provenance, optional embeddings behind the privacy gate.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Text search works without an embedding provider
- [ ] Knowledge items record source, scope, status and provenance
- [ ] LOCAL_ONLY blocks hosted embedding requests (test)

See docs/ROADMAP.md. Do not claim completion without evidence (README status wording).

issues.title: M4: Quote workflow
issues.body:
Enquiry to job to deterministic draft quote to owner approval, with audit.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Pricing is integer cents from approved rates; missing rates are reported, not guessed
- [ ] Viewer cannot approve; owner can (test)
- [ ] Approval writes an audit event in the same transaction
- [ ] Playwright journey covers the slice

See docs/ROADMAP.md. Do not claim completion without evidence (README status wording).
